chunks: My father, may Allah have mercy upon him, said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us from al-Harithi from Ziyad al-Qandi from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Sufficient victory from Allah for the believer is that he sees his enemy committing acts of disobedience to Allah.
ai.seo_question: What constitutes sufficient divine victory for a believer according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Sifat al-Shia*, this hadith defines spiritual victory not by material conquest but by the divine allowance of witnessing an enemy’s moral decay, a concept rooted in the Shia understanding of *nusrat* as both divine aid and psychological relief. This phenomenon reflects the principle that Allah’s favor often manifests through the removal of barriers or the exposure of the oppressor’s flaws, serving as a subtle sign of the believer’s steadfastness.
